game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: hummus123
quote: A buggy mess, I clipped through the group multiple times in the beginning. Whilst the relationship is cool it's annoying you can't cheat. Yes cheating is morally wrong but this game is about being a CRIMINAL. Can't even steal cars in your own neighborhood. Yes stealing cars in your own neighborhood is a bad ideal irl but the game should let you but with higher consequences. Regret my purchase.
